name: Resident Card, Dependent Spouse Category (Carte de Resident)

requirements.blocker_text: Dependent spouse status, evidenced by supporting/means-of-support documentation from the sponsoring spouse.
Minor children (both under 16 and 16+) require parental authorization to obtain their own resident card.

outcome.duration_length: requires periodic renewal; exact validity period not confirmed in sources fetched

sources.title: ONECI (Office National de l'Etat Civil et de l'Identification, Cote d'Ivoire) -- carte de resident, dependent-spouse category and minor-dependent provisions (parental authorization required for both under-16 and 16+ minors)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Cote d'Ivoire). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 ONECI sourced, though thin: the source lists 'dependent spouses' as a resident-card category requiring support documentation but does not specify whether the sponsor must be an Ivorian citizen or any resident-card holder (foreign or citizen) -- modeled broadly here (is_dependent_spouse_of_resident_or_citizen) pending clarification, disclosed as a gap. work_rights/family_can_work set to restricted/false as conservative defaults, not sourced figures. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the reduced 2-year-if-married naturalisation window ADDED to time already spent building the marriage's residence record -- see ci_citizenship_by_marriage.json for the actual 2024-reformed marriage-citizenship mechanism, which now runs on its own declaration track separate from ordinary naturalisation; this file's switchable_to point there rather than to the general naturalisation route.
